purpose.question: What does normal deadline delivery look like on the physical Thread topology before modelling or policy changes?
purpose.comparison: Repeated static runs with the same workload, no host model, and no remote actuation.
purpose.primary_metric: Reconciled on-time delivery ratio for the critical stream.

_todo.action: Freeze the real four-board topology only after upstream RCP and border-router attachment are repeatable.
_todo.method: Label the S3 gateway, RCP C6, router-capable C6, and low-power C6; survey the ordinary work area; select one 802.15.4 channel; mark board position, orientation, power path, and cables; then record actual Thread roles and binary identities.
_todo.done_when: The same configuration survives power cycling, IPv6 reachability is confirmed, and placement plus role evidence are archived before a reportable run.

_todo.action: Find a stable workload and run length that characterize normal variance without hiding queue behavior.
_todo.method: Use three pilot repetitions with one critical and one telemetry stream. Adjust only one offered-load dimension at a time until the queue remains bounded, all counters reconcile, and the measurement window contains enough critical releases to make a service ratio meaningful.
_todo.done_when: The ready file has frozen stream details, phase durations, seed, and repetition count derived from a traceable pilot decision.

_todo.action: Set an engineering service floor and raw-evidence requirement before calibration data is used by any model.
_todo.method: Choose a numerical critical on-time floor stricter than pilot noise, require reconciliation, set static/no-model/no-actuation treatment values, and require manifest, versions, topology, events, final counters, and operator notes in evidence.
_todo.done_when: Every baseline run can be classified complete, invalid, or interrupted without looking at a later model result.
